verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents official SDKs in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, .NET, Java, YAML and HCL, each with full Registry provider coverage. Automation API lets you embed the Pulumi engine as an SDK, and there is an ESC SDK. Hands-on users corroborate building with the TypeScript SDK and Automation API. Missing for 10: no evidenced official client SDK or published OpenAPI spec for the Pulumi Cloud REST API (OpenAPI probes returned 404), and Rust support is only experimental.
